description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Chamber Sentry from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
